title: Sughra Tanha Ujray Ghar Main
body:
Sughra tanha ujray ghar main aas lagaye baithi hai ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Dil main gaysuo’n walay ki tasveer banaye baithi hai..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Janay walay kab lotai’n gay yado’n kay eewano main
Ashko’n kay wo chotay deep jalaye baithi hai ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Band gharo’n kay darwazo’n ki veerani kya veerani hai
Jitna apni nazro’n ko veeran banaye baithi hai ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Jaltay khuwabo’n ki tabeerai’n poochay gi ab ro ro ker
Nani Salma ko wo ghar main aaj bulaye baithi hai ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Akbar aur Asghar ki batain khud say hi wo kertay kertay
Jitnay bhi hain ankho’n main wo ansoo laye baithi hai ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Meri bhi faryad suno ab meri manat poori ker do
Nana teray rozay per ek dukhiya aaye baithi hai ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Lagta hai Ejaz Amar yeh Sughra apnay ujray ghar main
Dil main bhai say milnay kay khuwab sajaye baithi hai..
